top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs two discoveries that each open a new capability with a stated principle: induced-proximity protein degradation credited to the original conceptualisers, Crews and Deshaies, and base editing as programmable chemical conversion of a DNA base without a double-strand break. The citations are narrow, separate the original demonstration from later refinement, and Liu's tractable TadA evolution carries the base-editing part. Attribution gaps (Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo, Nishida; Ciulli; the cereblon glue strand) and the short record are real costs, so I place the clean, mature B008 stand-alone prize next.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to any named candidate, and Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr are not candidates
